notes: WhaleChat 3.74.0 — contacts now behave: saving someone adds them once, to your list only, and you can message them immediately whether or not they saved you back. An incoming conversation is never blocked — opening it saves the sender to your contacts automatically, so their account stays saved until you remove it manually. The 'Add contact' notice is sent once per pair (no more repeat prompts), and a background sync refresh can no longer wipe a contact you just saved. Also fixes the add-on modules binding to the app core (live trade rails, sidebar P/L, chat engine).
